notice: All companies, services, versions and identifiers below are fictional and invented for demonstration.

cases.problem_signature: intermittent connection reset after request payload exceeds 2MB on orders-api
symptoms: client observes ECONNRESET on payloads above 2MB
investigation_trace: reproduced with a payload size sweep
compared reset threshold against proxy configuration
read the proxy upstream log for the failing requests

failed_approaches.approach: raised the client socket timeout to 60s
failed_approaches.why_failed: the proxy closed the stream before the client timeout applied

cases.root_cause: upstream proxy request-size limit truncated the stream
cases.resolution: raised proxy max_request_bytes to 8MB and re-ran the payload sweep
cases.verification_notes: synthetic case; the fix was confirmed by re-running the payload sweep with no resets above 2MB

cases.problem_signature: orders-api returns HTTP 502 only for payloads above 2MB
investigation_trace: captured the upstream 502 body instead of the local response
checked whether a proxy was present in front of the service

failed_approaches.approach: restarted the pods to clear suspected connection state
failed_approaches.why_failed: the symptom returned within minutes of the restart

cases.root_cause: upstream dependency returned 502 for oversized request bodies
cases.resolution: upstream team corrected body handling; no proxy change was made
cases.verification_notes: synthetic case; shares symptoms with seed-001 but has a different root cause and no proxy present

cases.problem_signature: large file uploads fail with connection reset behind nginx on media-uploader
symptoms: upload endpoint resets the connection for files above 2MB
investigation_trace: correlated failures with the request body size
searched the reverse proxy error log for the failing requests

failed_approaches.why_failed: the reverse proxy rejected the request before the client was involved

cases.root_cause: reverse proxy request body limit rejected the upload
cases.resolution: raised nginx client_max_body_size and re-tested uploads
cases.verification_notes: synthetic case; same failure class as seed-001 but a different service, runtime and proxy

cases.problem_signature: nightly batch job finishes 40 minutes late after growing run time
symptoms: batch completion time grew from 20 to 60 minutes over two weeks
investigation_trace: compared run durations day by day
listed the slowest queries observed during the run

failed_approaches.why_failed: the bottleneck was per-row query cost, not concurrency

cases.root_cause: unindexed lookup table made per-row queries scan the table
cases.resolution: added the missing index; runtime returned to 20 minutes
cases.verification_notes: synthetic case; intentionally unrelated to any network or payload failure family

cases.problem_signature: sporadic p99 latency spike on checkout-api lasting about 30 seconds
symptoms: p99 latency reaches 3x baseline for short bursts
investigation_trace: checked garbage collection pauses during the spikes

failed_approaches.why_failed: pause behaviour was unchanged after the limit increase

cases.resolution: workaround: rescheduled the batch job away from the checkout host
cases.verification_notes: synthetic case; root cause never confirmed, retained deliberately as a partial-match and abstain probe

cases.problem_signature: stale connection pool exhaustion on payments-api during peak traffic
symptoms: requests fail with pool exhausted errors for roughly 5 minutes
traffic returns to normal without intervention
investigation_trace: captured pool saturation during the failure window
compared checkout rates against pool return times

failed_approaches.approach: raised the pool size to 200 connections
failed_approaches.why_failed: connections were checked out and never returned, so a larger pool only delayed exhaustion

cases.root_cause: connections were leaked by a retry path and never returned to the pool
cases.resolution: fixed the retry path to release connections, then restored the original pool size
cases.verification_notes: synthetic case; distinct from the payload-size family and from the latency case
